speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are an 8-year-old having trouble sleeping and waking up frightened; can you tell me if you have ever seen strange figures or felt someone is near you when these episodes happen?

REQUEST TEST: Sleep_history_assessment
REQUEST IMAGES: If you are willing, we can review any recordings of these episodes.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Sleep_Diary: The patient's sleep diary reveals a pattern correlating with the described episodes, with noted disturbances occurring 1-2 times a week. Polysomnography: Not indicated at this stage based on history and normal physical examination.

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Difficulty sleeping with episodes of waking up frightened. I also have Yelling and crying during sleep episodes, Temporary post-episode tiredness, Recollection of bad dreams, Bedtime procrastination.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Met all developmental milestones with no significant medical history. Social history: Attends school regularly, with usual playing habits and interactions with peers. Lives with both parents.

speaker: Patient
text: No significant findings in other systems. No history of trauma or significant stress identified. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pyelonephritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terrors (Sleep Terrors)

I have noted that previous suggestions of Pyelonephritis are incorrect given your age and the specific symptom of waking up frightened, which is not a presentation of kidney infection. Since you mentioned no trauma or stress, we need to determine if these episodes occur during deep sleep or if there is a family history of similar events to confirm the nature of your sleep disorder.
